question: What are Qnami's current main threats? Give short bullet points
answer:
Here are Qnami’s current main threats, based on the most recent available information:

• Competition from established defense and tech firms  
  Companies such as Lockheed Martin, Honeywell, and others are investing heavily in quantum sensing and related technologies. These firms benefit from deep customer relationships, proven products, and long-standing government contracts, making it challenging for startups like Qnami to compete effectively ([pmarketresearch.com](https://pmarketresearch.com/it/quantum-magnetic-field-sensing-technology-market/?utm_source=openai)).

• High initial costs limiting adoption  
  Quantum sensors remain expensive—ranging from tens of thousands to over a million dollars—creating a significant barrier for smaller organizations and slowing market penetration ([marketresearch.com](https://www.marketresearch.com/Ken-Research-v3771/Quantum-Sensor-42981871/?utm_source=openai)).

• Talent scarcity and rising operational costs  
  The global shortage of specialized quantum engineers, physicists, and cryogenics experts drives up hiring costs and makes it difficult for startups to build and retain multidisciplinary teams ([pmarketresearch.com](https://pmarketresearch.com/it/quantum-magnetic-field-sensing-technology-market/?utm_source=openai)).

• Regulatory complexity and fragmented compliance requirements  
  Qnami faces lengthy certification timelines (12–18 months) and must navigate divergent regulatory regimes across regions—such as ITAR/EAR in the U.S., MDR in Europe, and evolving standards in Asia—adding cost and slowing time-to-market ([pmarketresearch.com](https://pmarketresearch.com/it/quantum-magnetic-field-sensing-technology-market/?utm_source=openai)).

• Limited awareness and understanding among potential users  
  A significant portion of industry professionals remain unfamiliar with quantum sensor capabilities, leading to hesitance in adoption and slower uptake of Qnami’s technology ([marketresearch.com](https://www.marketresearch.com/Ken-Research-v3771/Quantum-Sensor-42981871/?utm_source=openai)).

These threats collectively challenge Qnami’s ability to scale, compete, and expand globally in the rapidly evolving quantum sensing market.
